description: This file is a complex Python module that implements benchmarking and testing of various attention mechanisms, specifically for transformer models in the PyTorch framework. It includes functions for generating test configurations, executing different attention backends, measuring performance metrics, and outputting results in JSON format suitable for dashboards. It also contains a command-line interface to run batch experiments over multiple parameters.

classes.name: ExperimentConfig
classes.description: Dataclass representing a specific set of parameters for an attention experiment, including shape, type, data type, and backend options.

classes.name: Times
classes.description: Dataclass recording forward and backward times for experiments.

classes.name: ExperimentResults
classes.description: Dataclass storing results like forward time, backward time, and sparsity for an individual experiment.

classes.name: Experiment
classes.description: Dataclass combining configuration and resulting metrics of an experiment.
